1: GE FLIP ADVISOR - jar rebuilt 16:19
2: ==================================
3: 
4: This is now an advisor. It does not click, buy, sell or type anything. It
5: watches the OSRS Wiki price feed, works out which items can be bought low and
6: resold high *after* the 2% Grand Exchange tax, and shows you the exact
7: numbers. You place every offer yourself.
8: 
9: 
10: HOW TO OPEN IT
11: --------------
12: RuneLite sidebar -> "RSBuddy Scripts" -> choose "GE Flipper" in the script
13: dropdown -> Start.
14: 
15: A window called "GE Flip Advisor" opens (always on top). If you close it,
16: press Start again to bring it back. If you are not logged in yet the status
17: line says "Waiting for login"; prices start loading as soon as you are in
18: game.
19: 
20: 
21: WHAT TO DO WITH IT
22: ------------------
23: 1. "Starting capital (gp)" - type what you actually have. The window will not
24:    suggest anything you cannot afford, and it sizes each buy to that amount.
25: 
26: 2. "Free to play only" - ticked by default. Leave it ticked and member items
27:    are hidden. Untick it only if you want to see member trades.
28: 
29:    This box re-scans the moment you change it; you do not need Apply.
30: 
31: 3. The orange card is the pick. It reads like this:
32: 
33:        Buy 125 @ 3,403 gp  ->  list them at 3,614 gp
34: 
35:    Those are exact prices. Type those exact numbers into the GE. The line
36:    under it shows total profit after tax, total cost, 24h volume, buy limit,
37:    the break-even price and "never list below".
38: 
39: 4. "Copy name" puts the item name on your clipboard so you can paste it into
40:    the GE search box. "Next pick" cycles through the other candidates.
41: 
42: 5. Buy them, wait for the buy to fill, then sell them at the sell price. Do
43:    not list below the "never list below" number - that is the price that
44:    still covers what you paid plus tax plus your minimum profit.
45: 
46: 6. "Apply filters & rescan" after changing capital, min profit or anything in
47:    the advanced section. The list also refreshes itself every few seconds.
48: 
49: 
50: READING THE LIST
51: ----------------
52: "All picks" is sorted by total profit, biggest first. Columns:
53: 
54:     Item   Buy   Qty   Sell   Profit   ROI   Vol 24h   Limit
55: 
56: Buy and Sell are the exact prices to use. Qty is how many the window thinks
57: you can move: capped by your capital, the item's 4-hour buy limit, and 10% of
58: its daily traded volume so you are not left holding a pile nobody buys.
59: 
60: 
61: ADVANCED FILTERS (hidden by default)
62: ------------------------------------
63: Min ROI %          - profit as a percentage of the buy price
64: Min 24h volume     - ignore items that barely trade
65: Buy offset         - how far above the current low you offer (default +1)
66: Sell offset        - how far below the current high you list (default -1)
67: Max 24h price drift- reject items whose price has moved too far from its
68:                      24-hour average, which is how spikes and crashes get
69:                      filtered out
70: 
71: Defaults are deliberately picky: at least 50 gp profit per item, 1% ROI, 250
72: items traded per day, and no more than 8% drift from the 24h average.
73: 
74: 
75: IF IT SAYS "No pick right now"
76: ------------------------------
77: That is not an error. It means nothing passed every filter at that moment.
78: Usually the market is quiet, or your capital is too small for the items with
79: real volume. Try, in this order:
80: 
81:     1. Lower "Min profit per item" to 20-30 and press Apply.
82:     2. Lower "Min 24h volume" to 100.
83:     3. Raise "Max 24h price drift" to 12-15%.
84:     4. Wait a few minutes; the feed refreshes constantly.
85: 
86: 
87: THE HONEST CAVEATS
88: ------------------
89: - Prices come from the OSRS Wiki, not from your client. They are recent, not
90:   live: the low and high you see already happened. That is why the window
91:   rejects quotes older than 30 minutes and prices far from the daily average.
92: - A flip is only a plan. If the market moves between the scan and your offer,
93:   you may buy and then have to wait, or sell at break-even. The "never list
94:   below" number is what stops a bad sale from turning into a loss.
95: - Tax is always assumed: 2% of the sale price, rounded down, capped at 5m per
96:   item. A few items are exempt in game; assuming tax can only make the
97:   estimate more cautious, never less.
98: - The buy limit is per 4 hours, per item. The quantity already respects it.
99: - Nothing here can guarantee a profit. It cannot see other players' offers,
100:   only what has already traded.
101: 
102: 
103: WHERE THE LOGS GO
104: -----------------
105: Every line the window logs is also written to:
106: 
107:     %USERPROFILE%\.runelite\rsbuddy-flipper.log
108: 
109: If something looks wrong, just say so - I read that file directly, you do not
110: need to copy anything.
111: 
112: 
113: WHAT CHANGED IN THIS BUILD (16:19)
114: ----------------------------------
115: - Rewritten as an advisor: no clicking, no typing, no offers placed for you.
116: - Free to play toggle, on by default.
117: - Pick card with exact buy price, sell price, quantity and a hard floor.
118: - Member filtering now also asks the game client which items are member-only,
119:   so a wrong flag in the price feed cannot put a member item in your list.
120: - Scanning moved onto the game thread, where item data is safe to read.
121: - The old automation code (GeTrader) is still in the plugin but is not
122:   connected to this window.

33: /**
34:  * Owns the currently running script and dispatches game ticks to it.
35:  * <p>
36:  * Lifecycle methods are synchronized so the panel (EDT) and game thread can
37:  * start and stop scripts safely.
38:  */
39: public final class ScriptManager
40: {
41: 	private static final Logger log = LoggerFactory.getLogger(ScriptManager.class);
42: 
43: 	private final ScriptContext context;
44: 	private final List<Script> scripts = new ArrayList<>();
45: 
46: 	private Script activeScript;
47: 
48: 	public ScriptManager(ScriptContext context)
49: 	{
50: 		this.context = context;
51: 	}
52: 
53: 	public synchronized void register(Script script)
54: 	{
55: 		if (script != null && !scripts.contains(script))
56: 		{
57: 			scripts.add(script);
58: 		}
59: 	}
60: 
61: 	/**
62: 	 * Replaces a registered script, stopping it first if it is currently
63: 	 * running. Used when a script has been reloaded from newly compiled
64: 	 * classes.
65: 	 */
66: 	public synchronized void replace(Script oldScript, Script newScript)
67: 	{
68: 		if (oldScript == null || newScript == null)
69: 		{
70: 			return;
71: 		}
72: 
73: 		int index = scripts.indexOf(oldScript);
74: 		if (index >= 0)
75: 		{
76: 			scripts.set(index, newScript);
77: 		}
78: 		else if (!scripts.contains(newScript))
79: 		{
80: 			scripts.add(newScript);
81: 		}
82: 
83: 		if (activeScript == oldScript)
84: 		{
85: 			stop();
86: 		}
87: 	}
88: 
89: 	public synchronized List<Script> getScripts()
90: 	{
91: 		return Collections.unmodifiableList(new ArrayList<>(scripts));
92: 	}
93: 
94: 	public synchronized Script getActiveScript()
95: 	{
96: 		return activeScript;
97: 	}
98: 
99: 	public synchronized boolean isRunning()
100: 	{
101: 		return activeScript != null;
102: 	}
103: 
104: 	public synchronized String getStatus()
105: 	{
106: 		return activeScript == null ? "Idle" : activeScript.getStatus();
107: 	}
108: 
109: 	public synchronized void start(Script script)
110: 	{
111: 		if (script == null)
112: 		{
113: 			return;
114: 		}
115: 
116: 		if (activeScript != null)
117: 		{
118: 			stop();
119: 		}
120: 
121: 		activeScript = script;
122: 		context.getInput().setGroundItemPickupFilter(script.getGroundItemPickupFilter());
123: 		context.getInput().setFastMouse(script.useFastMouse());
124: 
125: 		try
126: 		{
127: 			script.start(context);
128: 		}
129: 		catch (Throwable ex)
130: 		{
131: 			log.error("Unable to start script {}", script.getName(), ex);
132: 			activeScript = null;
133: 			context.getInput().setGroundItemPickupFilter(null);
134: 			context.getInput().stopPileTracking();
135: 			context.getInput().setFastMouse(false);
136: 			script.setStatus("Error: " + ex.getMessage());
137: 
138: 			try
139: 			{
140: 				script.stop();
141: 			}
142: 			catch (Throwable stopEx)
143: 			{
144: 				log.warn("Unable to stop failed script {}", script.getName(), stopEx);
145: 			}
146: 		}
147: 	}
148: 
149: 	public synchronized void stop()
150: 	{
151: 		Script script = activeScript;
152: 		activeScript = null;
153: 
154: 		context.getInput().stopCamera();
155: 		context.getInput().setGroundItemPickupFilter(null);
156: 		context.getInput().stopPileTracking();
157: 		context.getInput().setFastMouse(false);
158: 
159: 		if (script == null)
160: 		{
161: 			return;
162: 		}
163: 
164: 		try
165: 		{
166: 			script.stop();
167: 		}
168: 		catch (Throwable ex)
169: 		{
170: 			log.warn("Unable to stop script {}", script.getName(), ex);
171: 			script.setStatus("Error: " + ex.getMessage());
172: 		}
173: 	}
174: 
175: 	public synchronized void onGameTick()
176: 	{
177: 		Script script = activeScript;
178: 		if (script == null)
179: 		{
180: 			return;
181: 		}
182: 
183: 		try
184: 		{
185: 			script.tick();
186: 		}
187: 		catch (Throwable ex)
188: 		{
189: 			log.error("Script {} failed", script.getName(), ex);
190: 			activeScript = null;
191: 			context.getInput().setGroundItemPickupFilter(null);
192: 			context.getInput().stopPileTracking();
193: 			context.getInput().setFastMouse(false);
194: 
195: 			try

202: 			}
203: 
204: 			script.setStatus("Error: " + ex.getMessage());
205: 		}

33: /**
34:  * Example script which finds a nearby object and clicks it.
35:  * <p>
36:  * This is intentionally small. Use it as a template for a state machine:
37:  * find a target, interact, wait for the game to update, then repeat.
38:  */
39: public final class ObjectInteractScript extends Script
40: {
41: 	private static final int CLICK_COOLDOWN_TICKS = 3;
42: 
43: 	private final String objectName;
44: 	private final String requiredAction;
45: 	private final int maxDistance;
46: 
47: 	private int cooldown;
48: 
49: 	public ObjectInteractScript(String objectName, String requiredAction, int maxDistance)
50: 	{
51: 		super("Object Interact", "Finds a nearby object and clicks it", 1);
52: 		this.objectName = objectName;
53: 		this.requiredAction = requiredAction;
54: 		this.maxDistance = maxDistance;
55: 	}
56: 
57: 	@Override
58: 	protected void onStart()
59: 	{
60: 		cooldown = 0;
61: 		setStatus("Looking for " + objectName);
62: 	}
63: 
64: 	@Override
65: 	protected void onGameTick()
66: 	{
67: 		ScriptContext context = getContext();
68: 
69: 		if (!context.isLoggedIn())
70: 		{
71: 			setStatus("Waiting for login");
72: 			return;
73: 		}
74: 
75: 		if (cooldown > 0)
76: 		{
77: 			--cooldown;
78: 			setStatus("Cooldown (" + cooldown + ")");
79: 			return;
80: 		}
81: 
82: 		Player player = context.getPlayer();
83: 		if (player.getAnimation() != -1)
84: 		{
85: 			setStatus("Waiting for player to become idle");
86: 			return;
87: 		}
88: 
89: 		Optional<GameObject> target = context.getTargets()
90: 			.findObject(objectName, requiredAction, maxDistance);
91: 		if (target.isEmpty())
92: 		{
93: 			setStatus("No " + objectName + " within " + maxDistance + " tiles");
94: 			return;
95: 		}
96: 
97: 		if (context.getInput().click(target.get()))
98: 		{
99: 			cooldown = CLICK_COOLDOWN_TICKS;
100: 			setStatus("Clicked " + objectName);
101: 		}
102: 		else
103: 		{
104: 			setStatus("Unable to click " + objectName);
105: 		}
106: 	}
107: }

40: 	{
41: 	}

43: 	public static Script load(String className, ClassLoader classLoader) throws ScriptLoadException
44: 	{

50: 	 * arguments. This allows reloaded scripts to be created with the same
51: 	 * options as the built-in registrations.

53: 	public static Script load(String className, ClassLoader classLoader, Object... arguments)
54: 		throws ScriptLoadException
55: 	{
56: 		if (className == null || className.trim().isEmpty())
57: 		{
58: 			throw new ScriptLoadException("Enter a script class name");
59: 		}
60: 
61: 		String name = className.trim();
62: 		Class<?> type;
63: 
64: 		try
65: 		{
66: 			type = Class.forName(name, true, classLoader);
67: 		}

71: 		}

75: 		}
76: 
77: 		if (!Script.class.isAssignableFrom(type))
78: 		{

80: 		}

259: 	{

261: 		{
262: 			GameObject[] gameObjects = tile.getGameObjects();
263: 			return gameObjects == null ? Stream.empty() : Arrays.stream(gameObjects);
264: 		})
265: 			.filter(Objects::nonNull);
266: 	}

268: 	private Stream<TileObject> tileObjects()
269: 	{
270: 		return tiles().flatMap(tile ->
271: 		{
272: 			List<TileObject> objects = new ArrayList<>();
273: 			GameObject[] gameObjects = tile.getGameObjects();
274: 			if (gameObjects != null)
275: 			{
276: 				Collections.addAll(objects, gameObjects);
277: 			}
278: 			if (tile.getGroundObject() != null)
279: 			{
280: 				objects.add(tile.getGroundObject());
281: 			}
282: 			if (tile.getWallObject() != null)
283: 			{
284: 				objects.add(tile.getWallObject());
285: 			}
286: 			if (tile.getDecorativeObject() != null)
287: 			{
288: 				objects.add(tile.getDecorativeObject());
289: 			}
290: 
291: 			return objects.stream().filter(Objects::nonNull);
292: 		});
293: 	}

295: 	private Stream<Tile> tiles()
296: 	{
297: 		WorldView worldView = client.getTopLevelWorldView();
298: 		if (worldView == null)
299: 		{
300: 			return Stream.empty();
301: 		}
302: 
303: 		Scene scene = worldView.getScene();
304: 		if (scene == null)
305: 		{
306: 			return Stream.empty();
307: 		}
308: 
309: 		Tile[][][] tiles = scene.getTiles();
310: 		int plane = worldView.getPlane();
311: 		if (tiles == null || plane < 0 || plane >= tiles.length)
312: 		{
313: 			return Stream.empty();
314: 		}
315: 
316: 		Tile[][] planeTiles = tiles[plane];
317: 		if (planeTiles == null)
318: 		{
319: 			return Stream.empty();
320: 		}
321: 
322: 		return Arrays.stream(planeTiles)
323: 			.filter(Objects::nonNull)
324: 			.flatMap(row -> Arrays.stream(row))
325: 			.filter(Objects::nonNull);
326: 	}

329: 	{
330: 		WorldView worldView = client.getTopLevelWorldView();
331: 		if (worldView == null)
332: 		{
333: 			return Stream.empty();
334: 		}
335: 
336: 		return worldView.npcs().stream()
337: 			.map(npc -> (NPC) npc)
338: 			.filter(npc -> !npc.isDead());
339: 	}

341: 	private boolean matchesName(GameObject object, String name)
342: 	{
343: 		if (name == null || name.isEmpty())
344: 		{
345: 			return true;
346: 		}
347: 
348: 		ObjectComposition composition = client.getObjectDefinition(object.getId());
349: 		return composition != null && clean(composition.getName()).equalsIgnoreCase(clean(name));
350: 	}

352: 	private boolean matchesName(NPC npc, String name)
353: 	{
354: 		if (name == null || name.isEmpty())
355: 		{
356: 			return true;
357: 		}
358: 
359: 		NPCComposition composition = npc.getComposition();
360: 		String npcName = composition == null ? npc.getName() : composition.getName();
361: 		return clean(npcName).equalsIgnoreCase(clean(name));
362: 	}
363: 
364: 	private boolean hasAction(GameObject object, String action)
365: 	{
366: 		ObjectComposition composition = client.getObjectDefinition(object.getId());
367: 		return composition != null && hasAction(composition.getActions(), action);
368: 	}

371: 	{
372: 		NPCComposition composition = npc.getComposition();
373: 		return composition != null && hasAction(composition.getActions(), action);
374: 	}

376: 	private static boolean hasAction(String[] actions, String action)
377: 	{
378: 		return actions != null && Arrays.stream(actions).filter(Objects::nonNull)
379: 			.anyMatch(candidate -> clean(candidate).equalsIgnoreCase(clean(action)));
380: 	}
381: 
382: 	private boolean isVisible(TileObject object)
383: 	{
384: 		Shape clickbox = object.getClickbox();
385: 		if (clickbox != null && isInViewport(clickbox))
386: 		{
387: 			return true;
388: 		}
389: 
390: 		Polygon tilePoly = object.getCanvasTilePoly();
391: 		return tilePoly != null && isInViewport(tilePoly);
392: 	}
393: 
394: 	private boolean isVisible(NPC npc)
395: 	{
396: 		Shape hull = npc.getConvexHull();
397: 		if (hull != null && isInViewport(hull))
398: 		{
399: 			return true;
400: 		}
401: 
402: 		Polygon tilePoly = npc.getCanvasTilePoly();
403: 		return tilePoly != null && isInViewport(tilePoly);
404: 	}
405: 
406: 	private boolean isInViewport(Shape shape)
407: 	{
408: 		if (shape == null)
409: 		{
410: 			return false;
411: 		}
412: 
413: 		int width = client.getViewportWidth();
414: 		int height = client.getViewportHeight();
415: 		if (width <= 0 || height <= 0)
416: 		{
417: 			return true;
418: 		}
419: 
420: 		// Shape.intersects is unreliable here: RuneLite's SimplePolygon only
421: 		// returns true when the viewport border crosses the polygon, not when
422: 		// the whole polygon is inside the viewport. Compare bounds instead.
423: 		Rectangle bounds = shape.getBounds();
424: 		if (bounds == null)
425: 		{
426: 			return false;
427: 		}
428: 
429: 		Rectangle viewport = new Rectangle(
430: 			client.getViewportXOffset(), client.getViewportYOffset(), width, height);
431: 		if (bounds.width <= 0 || bounds.height <= 0)
432: 		{
433: 			return viewport.contains(bounds.getLocation());
434: 		}
435: 
436: 		return viewport.intersects(bounds);
437: 	}
438: 
439: 	private static boolean withinDistance(WorldPoint point, WorldPoint origin, int maxDistance)
440: 	{
441: 		return maxDistance <= 0 || origin == null || distance(point, origin) <= maxDistance;
442: 	}
443: 
444: 	private static int distance(WorldPoint point, WorldPoint origin)
445: 	{
446: 		return point == null || origin == null ? Integer.MAX_VALUE : point.distanceTo(origin);
447: 	}
448: 
449: 	private static String clean(String value)
450: 	{
451: 		return value == null ? "" : TAGS.matcher(value).replaceAll("").trim();
452: 	}

320: 	{

325: 
326: 		for (Widget widget : widgets)
327: 		{
328: 			if (widget == null)

332: 
333: 			String[] actions = widget.getActions();
334: 			if (actions != null && Arrays.stream(actions)
335: 				.filter(action -> action != null)
336: 				.anyMatch(action -> action.equalsIgnoreCase("Inventory")))
337: 			{
338: 				Rectangle bounds = widget.getBounds();
339: 				if (bounds != null && !bounds.isEmpty())
340: 				{
341: 					return widget;
342: 				}
343: 			}
344: 
345: 			Widget found = findTabByAction(widget.getChildren());
346: 			if (found != null)
347: 			{
348: 				return found;
349: 			}
350: 
351: 			found = findTabByAction(widget.getDynamicChildren());
352: 			if (found != null)
353: 			{
354: 				return found;
355: 			}
356: 		}
357: 
358: 		return null;

401: 	private String registerCustomScript(String className)
402: 	{

404: 		{
405: 			return null;
406: 		}
407: 
408: 		try

422: 	{
423: 		Optional<Script> script = scriptManager.getScripts().stream()
424: 			.filter(candidate -> name == null
425: 				|| candidate.getName().equalsIgnoreCase(name)
426: 				|| candidate.getClass().getSimpleName().equalsIgnoreCase(name))
427: 			.findFirst();

438: 	Script startScript(Script script)
439: 	{
440: 		if (script == null || scriptManager == null)
441: 		{
442: 			return script;
443: 		}
444: 
445: 		Script target = script;
446: 
447: 		// Recreate the script with the current config. Reloaded scripts are
448: 		// created through their own class loader so the new code is kept.
449: 		try
450: 		{
451: 			target = createScript(script.getClass().getName(), script.getClass().getClassLoader());
452: 		}
453: 		catch (ScriptLoader.ScriptLoadException ex)
454: 		{
455: 			log.warn("Unable to recreate script {}, keeping the existing instance",
456: 				script.getClass().getName(), ex);
457: 			chat("RSBuddy: could not recreate " + script.getName() + ": " + ex.getMessage());
458: 		}
459: 
460: 		scriptManager.replace(script, target);
461: 		scriptManager.start(target);
462: 		chat("RSBuddy: started " + target.getName());
463: 		return target;
464: 	}

466: 	/**
467: 	 * Loads the selected script again from the newest compiled classes and
468: 	 * replaces the registered instance. The running script is stopped if it is
469: 	 * the one being reloaded.
470: 	 */
471: 	Script reloadScript(Script script)
472: 	{
473: 		if (script == null || scriptManager == null)
474: 		{
475: 			return script;
476: 		}
477: 
478: 		// When the client is running from the source tree, rebuild the module
479: 		// first so the reload always picks up the latest edits.
480: 		File projectDirectory = resolveProjectDirectory();
481: 		if (projectDirectory != null)
482: 		{
483: 			rebuildScripts(projectDirectory);
484: 		}
485: 
486: 		File classesRoot = resolveScriptClassesDirectory();
487: 		if (classesRoot == null || !classesRoot.isDirectory())

_Thinking:_

There is a local jagexcache with OSRS cache. We can use the cache library to dump object definitions and positions from the map regions. That means we can get exact names, actions, IDs, sizes, and positions for rooftop obstacles, and derive course sequences. That's a great path to doing this without asking the user.

Let me check the jagexcache contents and whether the cache module can be used via a small Java program / jshell. There's runelite-jshell module. Maybe easier: the cache library has examples. We can compile a small Java utility using the cache jar to print object definitions for IDs, and maybe map data. But object positions are in map data — we could scrape them from the cache via MapImageDumper? The cache module has region loading. But maybe simpler: obstacle IDs/names/actions are enough to detect them dynamically, and course order can be inferred from the known course sequence; walking between obstacles can use nearby object detection rather than hardcoded positions. For rooftop courses, the next obstacle is always nearby and visible-ish. But course detection vs. wrong obstacles is tricky. Hardcoded positions from cache would be more robust.

Let me inspect the OSRS cache size and format. Also check what data exists. But first, let me understand the script UI/config: TestConfig and TestPluginPanel. The panel lists scripts from ScriptManager names; adding a registered script is enough. Config maybe used for settings. Does the panel have per-script settings? Recent commit mentions "panel-script-settings". Let's inspect TestPluginPanel.

## Assistant

_Thinking:_

Great. Cache exists. Could use cache library to dump object IDs and map positions. But maybe there's a simpler offline source: RuneLite built-in agility plugin doesn't store course order beyond the IDs. For positions, we can find objects at runtime by ID and the script can keep an index through a list of obstacle IDs in course order, and walk toward the next one by scanning the scene for that ID. Since all rooftop course obstacles are in the loaded scene at once (usually), scanning by ID and interacting when within range works. The list from Obstacles.java is exactly in course order. That gives us a robust way: for each course, obstacles in order; find next obstacle ID in scene, walk within range if necessary, click the appropriate action (usually "Climb", "Cross", "Jump", "Swing", "Vault", "Walk-on", etc.). We can also just click the object (left-click default action) — rooftop obstacles' default left-click is the climb action. However some objects have multiple actions; left-click may be correct generally. Safer to use `interact(object, action)` with action string; but deriving exact action per obstacle is possible from cache definitions.

The bigger challenge: course start / lap reset and detecting when a lap is complete. Rooftop courses have a "lap" that ends by jumping down and then returning to start (e.g., Draynor crate teleports? Actually Draynor's lap ends with leap down near the start; then you climb wall again — the start obstacle is the wall climb). Sequence list includes all obstacles and then repeats from first. So if we simply loop through the obstacle list in order, after the last obstacle we walk back to the first obstacle and continue. That's how many agility bots work. Some courses include a "start" object (Canifis start tree, Varrock finish?), but the list seems to include all including start.

Potential problem: obstacles may share IDs or objects in scene could be in multiple places. But with one course loaded and using nearest object by ID, should be fine.

Another challenge: clicking obstacles may fail due to camera angle/offscreen. Need to rotate camera toward the object, or use `input.interact` which may handle. Let's inspect GameInput.interact(TileObject...) and related. Also check how existing scripts handle camera, obstacles, walking. Let's read relevant portions of GameInput (walkTo, interact, turnCamera). And read a complex script that moves around object interactions e.g. ArdougneBakerStallStealerScript, GemCrabKillerScript, FruitStallStealerScript to follow patterns. Let me inspect the bakery script's state machine and helpers.

44: public class ObjectManager
45: {
46: 	private final Store store;
47: 	private final Map<Integer, ObjectDefinition> objects = new HashMap<>();
48: 
49: 	public ObjectManager(Store store)
50: 	{
51: 		this.store = store;
52: 	}
53: 
54: 	public void load() throws IOException
55: 	{
56: 		ObjectLoader loader = new ObjectLoader();
57: 
58: 		Storage storage = store.getStorage();
59: 		Index index = store.getIndex(IndexType.CONFIGS);
60: 		Archive archive = index.getArchive(ConfigType.OBJECT.getId());
61: 
62: 		loader.configureForRevision(archive.getRevision());
63: 
64: 		byte[] archiveData = storage.loadArchive(archive);
65: 		ArchiveFiles files = archive.getFiles(archiveData);
66: 
67: 		for (FSFile f : files.getFiles())
68: 		{
69: 			ObjectDefinition def = loader.load(f.getFileId(), f.getContents());
70: 			objects.put(f.getFileId(), def);
71: 		}
72: 	}
73: 
74: 	public Collection<ObjectDefinition> getObjects()
75: 	{
76: 		return Collections.unmodifiableCollection(objects.values());
77: 	}
78: 
79: 	public ObjectDefinition getObject(int id)
80: 	{
81: 		return objects.get(id);
82: 	}
83: 
84: 	public void dump(File out) throws IOException
85: 	{
86: 		out.mkdirs();
87: 
88: 		for (ObjectDefinition def : objects.values())
89: 		{
90: 			ObjectExporter exporter = new ObjectExporter(def);
91: 
92: 			File targ = new File(out, def.getId() + ".json");
93: 			exporter.exportTo(targ);
94: 		}
95: 	}
96: 
97: 	public void java(File java) throws IOException
98: 	{
99: 		java.mkdirs();
100: 		try (IDClass ids = IDClass.create(java, "ObjectID");
101: 			IDClass nulls = IDClass.create(java, "NullObjectID"))
102: 		{
103: 			for (ObjectDefinition def : objects.values())
104: 			{
105: 				if ("null".equals(def.getName()))
106: 				{
107: 					nulls.add(def.getName(), def.getId());
108: 				}
109: 				else
110: 				{
111: 					ids.add(def.getName(), def.getId());
112: 				}
113: 			}
114: 		}
115: 	}

```json
    {
```

```
        failedClicks = 0;
```

```java
        sawMovement = false;
        lastLocation = null;
        statsInitialized = false;
        statsStartedAt = 0;
        startAgilityXp = 0;
        startLevel = 0;
        setStatus("Ready for Varrock");
    }

    @Override
    protected void onGameTick()
    {
        ScriptContext context = getContext();
        if (!context.isLoggedIn()) { resetWaiting(); setStatus("Waiting for login"); return; }

        if (walker == null) walker = new Walker(context.getClient(), context.getInput());

        updateStats();
        Player player = context.getPlayer();

        if (waiting)
        {
            updateWaiting(context, player);
            return;
        }

        if (clickCooldown > 0) { --clickCooldown; setStatus(...); return; } // maybe not needed

        Obstacle obstacle = COURSE.obstacles[index];

        // If the player is not on the correct plane for the next obstacle,
        // wait a couple of ticks for transitions, then recover.
        if (player.getWorldLocation() != null && player.getWorldLocation().getPlane() != obstacle.location.getPlane())
        {
            ++missingTicks;
            if (missingTicks >= MAX_MISSING_TICKS) {
                recover("step off the course");
            } else {
                setStatus("Waiting for the course to load");
            }
            return;
        }

        if (context.getClient().isMenuOpen()) { context.getInput().closeMenu(); setStatus("Closing menu"); return; }
        if (context.getInput().isBusy()) { setStatus("Moving mouse"); return; }
        if (isAnimating(player)) { setStatus("Waiting for animation"); return; }

        TileObject target = findObstacle(context, obstacle);
        if (target == null)
        {
            if (++missingTicks >= MAX_MISSING_TICKS) recover("lost " + obstacle.name);
            else setStatus("Looking for " + obstacle.name);
            return;
        }
        missingTicks = 0;

        WorldPoint targetLocation = target.getWorldLocation();
        WorldPoint playerLocation = player.getWorldLocation();
        int distance = playerLocation == null || targetLocation == null ? Integer.MAX_VALUE : playerLocation.distanceTo(targetLocation);

        if (distance > (index == 0 ? START_WALK_DISTANCE : MAX_INTERACT_DISTANCE))
        {
            if (walker.walkTo(obstacle.location, false, index == 0 ? 3 : MAX_INTERACT_DISTANCE - 1))
                setStatus("Walking to " + obstacle.name);
            else
                setStatus("Can't reach " + obstacle.name + " - walking to start");
            // if no path after some ticks? Maybe recover after missing ticks.
            return;
        }

        if (!context.getInput().isVisible(target))
        {
            if (context.getInput().isCameraBusy() || context.getInput().turnCameraToward(targetLocation))
            {
                setStatus("Turning camera to " + obstacle.name);
                return;
            }
        }
        context.getInput().stopCamera();

        if (context.getInput().interact(target, obstacle.action))
        {
            beginWaiting(playerLocation);
            setStatus("Clicked " + obstacle.name);
        }
        else
        {
            if (++failedClicks >= MAX_CLICK_ATTEMPTS)
            {
                failedClicks = 0;
                recover("could not click " + obstacle.name);
            }
            else
            {
                setStatus("Retrying " + obstacle.name);
            }
        }
    }
```

```
@Override
public List<String> getOverlayLines()
{
    if (!statsInitialized) return Collections.emptyList();
    long elapsed = Math.max(1L, System.currentTimeMillis() - statsStartedAt);
    Client client = getContext().getClient();
    long gainedXp = Math.max(0L, client.getSkillExperience(Skill.AGILITY) - startAgilityXp);
    List<String> lines = new ArrayList<>();
    lines.add("");
    lines.add("Varrock rooftop course");
    lines.add("Laps: " + formatNumber(laps) + " (" + formatPerHour(laps, elapsed) + "/hr)");
    lines.add("Obstacles: " + formatNumber(obstaclesCompleted));
    lines.add("XP/hr: " + formatNumber(perHour(gainedXp, elapsed)));
    lines.add("Time: " + formatDuration(elapsed));
    return lines;
}
```

```
@Override
public List<ProgressBar> getProgressBars()
{
    if (!statsInitialized) return Collections.emptyList();
    Client client = getContext().getClient();
    int level = client.getRealSkillLevel(Skill.AGILITY);
    if (level >= Experience.MAX_REAL_LEVEL) return Collections.singletonList(new ProgressBar("Agility", 1.0, "Max level", Color.GREEN));
    long xp = client.getSkillExperience(Skill.AGILITY);
    long current = Experience.getXpForLevel(level);
    long next = Experience.getXpForLevel(level + 1);
    return Collections.singletonList(new ProgressBar("Agility", (double)(xp-current)/(next-current), formatNumber(xp) + " / " + formatNumber(next), Color.GREEN));
}
```

		try

			updatePileTrackingUnsafe();

		catch (RuntimeException | AssertionError ex)
		{
			log.warn("{} pile tracking failed, stopping it", pileLogPrefix, ex);
			pileActive = false;
			pileStatus = PileStatus.IDLE;
		}
	}

	/**
	 * Finds the Take entry for the exact ground item stack at the given
	 * scene coordinates. Entries for other nearby tiles are ignored: when
	 * drops overlap, the menu can contain several items with the same id,
	 * and taking one of those would pick up the wrong item.
	 */
	private MenuEntry findGroundItemMenuEntry(int itemId, int sceneX, int sceneY)
	{
		int id = itemId & 0xFFFF;

		for (MenuEntry entry : currentMenuEntries())
		{
			if (entry == null || !isGroundItemAction(entry.getType())
				|| !matchesOption(entry.getOption(), "Take", "Pick up", "Pickup"))
			{
				continue;
			}

			if (entry.getParam0() == sceneX
				&& entry.getParam1() == sceneY
				&& (entry.getIdentifier() & 0xFFFF) == id)
			{
				return entry;
			}
		}

		return null;
	}

	private static boolean isGroundItemAction(MenuAction type)
	{
		if (type == null)
		{
			return false;
		}

		int id = type.getId();
		return id >= MenuAction.GROUND_ITEM_FIRST_OPTION.getId()
			&& id <= MenuAction.GROUND_ITEM_FIFTH_OPTION.getId();
	}

	private static boolean matchesOption(String option, String... actions)
	{
		if (option == null || actions == null)
		{
			return false;
		}

		String plainOption = stripTags(option);
		for (String action : actions)
		{
			if (action != null && plainOption.equalsIgnoreCase(stripTags(action)))
			{
				return true;
			}
		}

		return false;
	}

	public boolean clickMinimap(WorldPoint point)
	{
		LocalPoint localPoint = LocalPoint.fromWorld(client, point);
		if (localPoint == null)
		{
			return false;
		}

		net.runelite.api.Point minimapPoint = Perspective.localToMinimap(client, localPoint);
		return minimapPoint != null
			&& input.click(new Point(minimapPoint.getX(), minimapPoint.getY()));

	/**
	 * @return true if a walkable route reaches the goal
	 */
	public boolean canReach(WorldPoint goal)
	{
		List<WorldPoint> path = findPath(goal);
		if (path.isEmpty())
		{
			return false;
		}

		WorldPoint end = path.get(path.size() - 1);
		return end.distanceTo(goal) <= 1;
	}

	/**
	 * Finds a walkable route from the player to the goal. When the goal cannot
	 * be reached, the route ends at the reachable tile closest to it.
	 *
	 * @return the route, including the player's current tile
	 */
	public List<WorldPoint> findPath(WorldPoint goal)
	{
		Player player = client.getLocalPlayer();
		WorldPoint start = player == null ? null : player.getWorldLocation();
		WorldView worldView = client.getTopLevelWorldView();
		if (start == null || goal == null || worldView == null)
		{
		if (!client.isMenuOpen())
		{
			return false;
		}

		MenuEntry entry = findGroundItemMenuEntry(itemId, sceneX, sceneY);
		if (entry == null)
		{
			closeMenu();
			return false;
		}
		return clickMenuEntry(entry);
	}

	/**
	 * Runs this item's exact Take on its tile without a mouse click. Take is
	 * the third ground-item option.
	 */
	public boolean invokeGroundItemTake(int sceneX, int sceneY, int itemId, String itemName)
	{
		client.menuAction(sceneX, sceneY, MenuAction.GROUND_ITEM_THIRD_OPTION, itemId, -1, "Take",
			itemName == null ? "" : itemName);
		return true;
	}

	/**
	 * Picks a point on the middle of a tile, where a ground item's model sits.
	 * With only the wanted drops left clickable, a click that misses the model
	 * walks instead of taking the item, so the point stays close to the centre
	 * rather than spread across the whole tile.
	 */
	private Point itemPoint(Polygon tilePoly)
	{
		if (tilePoly == null)
		{
			return null;
		}

		Rectangle bounds = tilePoly.getBounds();
		if (bounds == null || bounds.isEmpty())
		{
			return null;
		}

		int centerX = bounds.x + bounds.width / 2;
		int centerY = bounds.y + bounds.height / 2;

		for (int attempt = 0; attempt < RANDOM_POINT_ATTEMPTS; attempt++)
		{
			int x = centerX + random.nextInt(7) - 3;
			int y = centerY + random.nextInt(7) - 3;
			if (tilePoly.contains(x, y) && isInViewport(x, y) && !isCoveredByInterface(x, y))
			{
				return new Point(x, y);
			}
		}

		return randomPoint(tilePoly);
	}

	 * Picks a point in the lower part of a tile. Ground item models extend

	 * clicking low on the tile keeps the menu on the intended drop.

	private Point randomTilePoint(Polygon tilePoly)

```java
private static final int MARK_PICKUP_DISTANCE = 6;
private static final int MARK_RETRY_TICKS = 5;
private static final int MARK_ATTEMPT_LIMIT = 3;
private static final int MARK_IGNORE_TICKS = 100;
private static final int MARK_WALK_TIMEOUT_TICKS = 40;
```

`findMark(ScriptContext context, Player player)`:
```java
private GroundLoot findMark(ScriptContext context, Player player)
{
    WorldPoint playerLocation = player.getWorldLocation();
    if (playerLocation == null || playerLocation.getPlane() <= 0) return null;
    WorldView worldView = context.getClient().getTopLevelWorldView();
    if (worldView == null) return null;
    Scene scene = worldView.getScene();
    if (scene == null) return null;
    Tile[][][] tiles = scene.getTiles();
    int plane = playerLocation.getPlane();
    if (tiles == null || plane < 0 || plane >= tiles.length) return null;
    Tile[][] planeTiles = tiles[plane];
    if (planeTiles == null) return null;

    GroundLoot best = null;
    int bestDistance = Integer.MAX_VALUE;
    for (Tile[] row : planeTiles) {
        if (row == null) continue;
        for (Tile tile : row) {
            if (tile == null) continue;
            List<TileItem> items = tile.getGroundItems();
            if (items == null || items.isEmpty()) continue;
            WorldPoint itemLocation = tile.getWorldLocation();
            Point sceneLocation = tile.getSceneLocation();
            if (itemLocation == null || sceneLocation == null) continue;
            if (itemLocation.getPlane() != plane) continue;
            int distance = itemLocation.distanceTo(playerLocation);
            if (distance > MARK_PICKUP_DISTANCE) continue;
            if (isIgnoredMark(itemLocation)) continue;
            boolean hasMark = false;
            for (TileItem item : items) {
                if (item != null && item.getId() == ItemID.GRACE) { hasMark = true; break; }
            }
            if (!hasMark) continue;
            if (distance >= bestDistance) continue;
            // Confirm the player can actually walk there from this section of the course.
            if (!walker.canReach(itemLocation)) continue;
            bestDistance = distance;
            best = new GroundLoot(sceneLocation.getX(), sceneLocation.getY(), itemLocation);
        }
    }
    return best;
}
```

```java
private boolean updateMarkPickup(ScriptContext context, Player player)
{
    if (markTarget != null && !markStillPresent(context, markTarget))
    {
        // The mark was taken (or despawned).
        markTarget = null;
        markTicks = 0;
        markAttempts = 0;
        refreshMarkCount(context);
        return true; // let the next tick continue with obstacles? returning true just delays one tick; fine
    }

    if (markTarget == null)
    {
        GroundLoot mark = findMark(context, player);
        if (mark == null) return false;
        markTarget = mark;
        markTicks = 0;
        markAttempts = 0;
    }

    ++markTicks;

    WorldPoint playerLocation = player.getWorldLocation();
    WorldPoint markLocation = markTarget.location;
    int distance = playerLocation == null ? Integer.MAX_VALUE : playerLocation.distanceTo(markLocation);

    // If the player is no longer on the mark's plane (fell), drop it.
    if (playerLocation == null || playerLocation.getPlane() != markLocation.getPlane())
    {
        markTarget = null;
        markTicks = 0;
        markAttempts = 0;
        return false;
    }

    if (distance > 1)
    {
        if (markTicks >= MARK_WALK_TIMEOUT_TICKS)
        {
            ignoreMark(markLocation);
            markTarget = null;
            markTicks = 0;
            markAttempts = 0;
            return false; // continue with obstacle this tick
        }
        if (walker.walkTo(markLocation, false, 1))
        {
            setStatus("Walking to Mark of Grace");
        }
        else
        {
            setStatus("Walking to Mark of Grace");
        }
        return true;
    }

    // Close enough: take it.
    if (markTicks >= MARK_RETRY_TICKS)
    {
        markTicks = 0;
        if (++markAttempts >= MARK_ATTEMPT_LIMIT)
        {
            ignoreMark(markLocation);
            markTarget = null;
            markAttempts = 0;
            return false;
        }
    }
    else if (markAttempts > 0)
    {
        // Waiting for the previous take click to finish.
        setStatus("Taking Mark of Grace");
        return true;
    }

    context.getInput().invokeGroundItemTake(markTarget.sceneX, markTarget.sceneY, ItemID.GRACE, "Mark of grace");
    setStatus("Taking Mark of Grace");
    return true;
}
```

Simpler: locate via scene tiles using scene coordinates:

```java
private boolean markStillPresent(ScriptContext context, GroundLoot mark)
{
    WorldView worldView = context.getClient().getTopLevelWorldView();
    if (worldView == null) return false;
    Scene scene = worldView.getScene();
    if (scene == null) return false;
    Tile[][][] tiles = scene.getTiles();
    int plane = mark.location.getPlane();
    if (tiles == null || plane < 0 || plane >= tiles.length) return false;
    Tile[][] planeTiles = tiles[plane];
    if (planeTiles == null) return false;
    int sceneX = mark.sceneX;
    int sceneY = mark.sceneY;
    if (sceneY < 0 || sceneY >= planeTiles.length) return false;
    Tile[] row = planeTiles[sceneY];
    if (row == null || sceneX < 0 || sceneX >= row.length) return false;
    Tile tile = row[sceneX];
    if (tile == null) return false;
    List<TileItem> items = tile.getGroundItems();
    if (items == null) return false;
    for (TileItem item : items) if (item != null && item.getId() == ItemID.GRACE) return true;
    return false;
}
```

```java
	private boolean updateMarkPickup(ScriptContext context, Player player)
	{
		if (markTarget != null && !markStillPresent(context, markTarget))
		{
			// The mark was picked up, despawned, or the player left the area.
			clearMarkTarget();
			return true;
		}

		WorldPoint playerLocation = player.getWorldLocation();
		if (playerLocation == null || playerLocation.getPlane() <= 0)
		{
			clearMarkTarget();
			return false;
		}

		if (markTarget == null)
		{
			markTarget = findMark(context, player);
			if (markTarget == null)
			{
				return false;
			}

			markTicks = 0;
			markAttempts = 0;
		}

		++markTicks;

		WorldPoint markLocation = markTarget.location;

		// Falling off the course changes the plane; never chase a mark from
		// another section, even if its tile is close on the map.
		if (playerLocation.getPlane() != markLocation.getPlane())
		{
			clearMarkTarget();
			return false;
		}

		int distance = playerLocation.distanceTo(markLocation);
		if (distance > 1)
		{
			if (markTicks >= MARK_WALK_TIMEOUT_TICKS)
			{
				ignoreMark(markLocation);
				clearMarkTarget();
				return false;
			}

			walker.walkTo(markLocation, false, 1);
			setStatus("Walking to Mark of Grace");
			return true;
		}

		if (markAttempts >= MARK_ATTEMPT_LIMIT)
		{
			ignoreMark(markLocation);
			clearMarkTarget();
			return false;
		}

		if (markAttempts > 0 && markTicks < MARK_RETRY_TICKS)
		{
			setStatus("Taking Mark of Grace");
			return true;
		}

		context.getInput().invokeGroundItemTake(markTarget.sceneX, markTarget.sceneY,
			ItemID.GRACE, MARK_NAME);
		++markAttempts;
		markTicks = 0;
		setStatus("Taking Mark of Grace");
		return true;
	}
```

E.g., the mark was reachable at the current section, player clicks the obstacle before... no, while a markTarget exists, we never click obstacles. So the player only moves toward the mark. Distance stays <= 6 or decreases. canReach stays valid. Good.

8. What if the player gets stuck walking to the mark (blocked by a random player or object) — after 40 ticks blacklist. Fine.

9. `ignoreMark` stores by WorldPoint; marks respawn at different positions. Fine.

10. Overlay marksCollected refresh: `updateStats` is called only when not waiting? No — onGameTick calls updateStats before the waiting branch, so every tick. Good.

Could be because onGameTick calls interact repeatedly while busy? No, `isBusy()` guards. But look at the flow:

The mouse takes maybe 1-2 seconds; the player may move during that time (walking toward the obstacle due to a previous walk click) so the click lands where the object was, not where it is. 149: 
150: 	private GroundLoot markTarget;
151: 	private int markTicks;
152: 	private int markAttempts;
153: 	private final Map<WorldPoint, Integer> ignoredMarks = new HashMap<>();
154: 
155: 	private boolean statsInitialized;
156: 	private long statsStartedAt;
157: 	private long startAgilityXp;
158: 	private int lastMarkCount;
159: 	private int marksCollected;
160: 
161: 	public RooftopAgilityTrainerScript()
162: 	{
163: 		super("Rooftop Agility Trainer", "Runs the Varrock rooftop agility course and recovers from falls.");
164: 	}
165: 
166: 	@Override
167: 	protected void onStart()
168: 	{
169: 		walker = null;
170: 		index = 0;
171: 		laps = 0;
172: 		obstaclesCompleted = 0;
173: 		missingTicks = 0;
174: 		failedClicks = 0;
175: 		stuckTicks = 0;
176: 		lastWalkLocation = null;
177: 		aligned = false;
178: 		waiting = false;
179: 		waitTicks = 0;
180: 		sawAnimation = false;
181: 		sawMovement = false;
182: 		lastLocation = null;
183: 		stableTicks = 0;
184: 		markTarget = null;
185: 		markTicks = 0;
186: 		markAttempts = 0;
187: 		ignoredMarks.clear();
188: 		statsInitialized = false;
189: 		statsStartedAt = 0;
190: 		startAgilityXp = 0;
191: 		lastMarkCount = 0;
192: 		marksCollected = 0;
193: 		setStatus("Ready for Varrock");
194: 	}
195: 
196: 	@Override
197: 	protected void onGameTick()
198: 	{
199: 		ScriptContext context = getContext();
200: 
201: 		if (!context.isLoggedIn())
202: 		{
203: 			waiting = false;
204: 			setStatus("Waiting for login");
205: 			return;
206: 		}
207: 
208: 		tickIgnoredMarks();
209: 
210: 		if (walker == null)
211: 		{
212: 			walker = new Walker(context.getClient(), context.getInput());
213: 		}
214: 
215: 		updateStats();
216: 
217: 		Player player = context.getPlayer();
218: 		if (player == null)
219: 		{
220: 			setStatus("Waiting for player");
221: 			return;
222: 		}
223: 
224: 		if (!aligned)
225: 		{
226: 			alignToCourse(player);
227: 			aligned = true;
228: 		}
229: 
230: 		if (waiting)
231: 		{
232: 			updateWaiting(player);
233: 			return;
234: 		}
235: 
236: 		if (context.getClient().isMenuOpen())
237: 		{
238: 			context.getInput().closeMenu();
239: 			setStatus("Closing menu");
240: 			return;
241: 		}
242: 
243: 		if (context.getInput().isBusy())
244: 		{
245: 			setStatus("Moving mouse");
246: 			return;
247: 		}
248: 
249: 		if (isAnimating(player))
250: 		{
251: 			setStatus("Waiting for animation");
252: 			return;
253: 		}
254: 
255: 		Obstacle obstacle = COURSE.obstacles[index];
256: 		WorldPoint playerLocation = player.getWorldLocation();
257: 
258: 		// A fall drops the player off the rooftop. The next obstacle is then on
259: 		// another plane (or out of reach), so reset to the first obstacle.
260: 		if (playerLocation != null && playerLocation.getPlane() != obstacle.location.getPlane())
261: 		{
262: 			if (++missingTicks >= MAX_MISSING_TICKS)
263: 			{
264: 				recover("off the course");
265: 			}
266: 			else
267: 			{
268: 				setStatus("Waiting for " + obstacle.name);
269: 			}
270: 			return;
271: 		}
272: 
273: 		// Marks of grace are only picked up when the player is on the course
274: 		// section the mark is on and a walkable route actually reaches it.
275: 		if (updateMarkPickup(context, player))
276: 		{
277: 			return;
278: 		}
279: 
280: 		TileObject target = findObstacle(context, obstacle);
281: 		if (target == null)
282: 		{
283: 			// The obstacle is not loaded yet, so the player is too far away
284: 			// (a fall can drop them well off the course). Walk back toward it
285: 			// instead of waiting for it to appear.
286: 			if (playerLocation != null
287: 				&& playerLocation.distanceTo(obstacle.location) > SEARCH_RADIUS)
288: 			{
289: 				walkToward(obstacle.location, index == 0 ? 3 : 4, obstacle.name);
290: 				return;
291: 			}
292: 
293: 			if (++missingTicks >= MAX_MISSING_TICKS)
294: 			{
295: 				recover("lost " + obstacle.name);
296: 			}
297: 			else
298: 			{
299: 				setStatus("Looking for " + obstacle.name);
300: 			}
301: 			return;
302: 		}
303: 
304: 		missingTicks = 0;
305: 
306: 		WorldPoint targetLocation = target.getWorldLocation();
307: 		int distance = playerLocation == null || targetLocation == null
308: 			? Integer.MAX_VALUE
309: 			: playerLocation.distanceTo(targetLocation);
310: 
311: 		// On the rooftop, click the next obstacle from where the player
312: 		// landed, even if it still looks a little far: walking closer just
313: 		// clicks pathway tiles and can send the player off the course. If the
314: 		// click does nothing, the failure path walks closer and retries.
315: 		int walkDistance = index == 0 || failedClicks > 0
316: 			? START_WALK_DISTANCE
317: 			: MAX_DIRECT_CLICK_DISTANCE;
318: 		boolean clickFromHere = distance <= walkDistance
319: 			|| (index > 0 && failedClicks == 0 && context.getInput().isVisible(target));
320: 
321: 		if (!clickFromHere)
322: 		{
323: 			walkToward(obstacle.location, index == 0 ? 3 : 4, obstacle.name);
324: 			return;
325: 		}
326: 
327: 		// The object is close enough to use, but if the camera is facing away
328: 		// there is nothing to click on screen. Face it instead of walking.
329: 		if (!context.getInput().isVisible(target))
330: 		{
331: 			if (context.getInput().isCameraBusy()
332: 				|| context.getInput().turnCameraToward(targetLocation))
333: 			{
334: 				setStatus("Turning camera to " + obstacle.name);
335: 				return;
336: 			}
337: 		}
338: 
339: 		context.getInput().stopCamera();
340: 
341: 		// Click the obstacle so the mouse visibly moves. The first attempts
342: 		// use a real left click; if the object's clickbox keeps getting
343: 		// obstructed (large gaps share space with other scenery), the exact
344: 		// option is dispatched directly instead of clicking around forever.
345: 		boolean sent;
346: 		if (failedClicks >= MAX_CLICK_ATTEMPTS - 1)
347: 		{
348: 			sent = context.getInput().invokeObjectAction(target, obstacle.action);
349: 		}
350: 		else
351: 		{
352: 			sent = context.getInput().interact(target, obstacle.action);
353: 		}
354: 
355: 		if (sent)
356: 		{
357: 			beginWaiting(playerLocation);
358: 			setStatus("Clicked " + obstacle.name);
359: 		}
360: 		else if (++failedClicks >= MAX_CLICK_ATTEMPTS)
361: 		{
362: 			recover("could not click " + obstacle.name);
363: 		}
364: 		else
365: 		{
366: 			setStatus("Retrying " + obstacle.name);
367: 		}
368: 	}
369: 
370: 	private void beginWaiting(WorldPoint playerLocation)
371: 	{
372: 		waiting = true;
373: 		waitTicks = 0;
374: 		sawAnimation = false;
375: 		sawMovement = false;
376: 		lastLocation = playerLocation;
377: 		stableTicks = 0;
378: 		lastWalkLocation = null;
379: 		stuckTicks = 0;
380: 	}
381: 
382: 	/**
383: 	 * Walks toward an obstacle and recovers if the player has not moved for
384: 	 * too long. The walker intentionally skips some ticks between clicks, so
385: 	 * only actual player movement resets the stall counter.
386: 	 */
387: 	private void walkToward(WorldPoint target, int stopDistance, String name)
388: 	{
389: 		Player player = getContext().getPlayer();
390: 		WorldPoint location = player == null ? null : player.getWorldLocation();
391: 
392: 		if (location != null && location.equals(lastWalkLocation))
393: 		{
394: 			++stuckTicks;
395: 		}
396: 		else
397: 		{
398: 			lastWalkLocation = location;
399: 			stuckTicks = 0;
400: 		}
401: 
402: 		if (stuckTicks >= MAX_STUCK_TICKS)
403: 		{
404: 			recover("cannot reach " + name);
405: 			return;
406: 		}
407: 
408: 		walker.walkTo(target, false, stopDistance);
409: 		setStatus("Walking to " + name);
410: 	}
411: 
412: 	private void updateWaiting(Player player)
413: 	{
414: 		++waitTicks;
415: 
416: 		WorldPoint location = player.getWorldLocation();
417: 		if (isAnimating(player))
418: 		{
419: 			sawAnimation = true;
420: 		}
421: 
422: 		if (lastLocation != null && location != null && !lastLocation.equals(location))
423: 		{
424: 			sawMovement = true;
425: 			stableTicks = 0;
426: 		}
427: 		else
428: 		{
429: 			++stableTicks;
430: 		}
431: 
432: 		lastLocation = location;
433: 
434: 		Obstacle obstacle = COURSE.obstacles[index];
435: 		boolean animationDone = !isAnimating(player);
436: 		boolean movementDone = stableTicks >= 1;
437: 
438: 		if (sawAnimation && animationDone && movementDone)
439: 		{
440: 			if (fellOff(location))
441: 			{
442: 				recover("fell on " + obstacle.name);
443: 				return;
444: 			}
445: 
446: 			completeObstacle();
447: 			return;
448: 		}
449: 
450: 		// Moving without the obstacle's animation means the click was treated
451: 		// as a walk (or hit something else) instead of starting the obstacle.
452: 		// Let the player stop, then click the obstacle again.
453: 		if (!sawAnimation && sawMovement && stableTicks >= 2 && waitTicks >= 6)
454: 		{
455: 			waiting = false;
456: 
457: 			if (++failedClicks >= MAX_CLICK_ATTEMPTS)
458: 			{
459: 				recover("could not start " + obstacle.name);
460: 			}
461: 			else
462: 			{
463: 				setStatus("Retrying " + obstacle.name);
464: 			}
465: 			return;
466: 		}
467: 
468: 		if (waitTicks >= OBSTACLE_TIMEOUT_TICKS)
469: 		{
470: 			waiting = false;
471: 			recover("timed out on " + obstacle.name);
472: 			return;
473: 		}
474: 
475: 		if (!sawAnimation && !sawMovement && waitTicks >= CLICK_FAILURE_TICKS)
476: 		{
477: 			waiting = false;
478: 
479: 			if (++failedClicks >= MAX_CLICK_ATTEMPTS)
480: 			{
481: 				recover("click did nothing on " + obstacle.name);
482: 			}
483: 			else
484: 			{
485: 				setStatus("Retrying " + obstacle.name);
486: 			}
487: 			return;
488: 		}
489: 
490: 		setStatus("Doing " + obstacle.name);
491: 	}
492: 
493: 	private void completeObstacle()
494: 	{
495: 		waiting = false;
496: 		failedClicks = 0;
497: 		missingTicks = 0;
498: 		stuckTicks = 0;
499: 		lastWalkLocation = null;
500: 
501: 		++obstaclesCompleted;
502: 
503: 		if (index + 1 < COURSE.obstacles.length)
504: 		{
505: 			++index;
506: 			setStatus("Next: " + COURSE.obstacles[index].name);
507: 		}
508: 		else
509: 		{
510: 			++laps;
511: 			index = 0;
512: 			setStatus("Lap complete (" + laps + ")");
513: 		}
514: 
515: 		if (walker != null)
516: 		{
517: 			walker.reset();
518: 		}
519: 	}
520: 
521: 	/**
522: 	 * @return true if the player is not on the plane the course continues on,
523: 	 * which means the obstacle failed and dropped them off the rooftop
524: 	 */
525: 	private boolean fellOff(WorldPoint location)
526: 	{
527: 		if (location == null)
528: 		{
529: 			return false;
530: 		}
531: 
532: 		int expectedPlane = index + 1 < COURSE.obstacles.length
533: 			? COURSE.obstacles[index + 1].location.getPlane()
534: 			: 0;
535: 		return location.getPlane() != expectedPlane;
536: 	}
537: 
538: 	private void recover(String reason)
539: 	{
540: 		index = 0;
541: 		waiting = false;
542: 		missingTicks = 0;
543: 		failedClicks = 0;
544: 		stuckTicks = 0;
545: 		lastWalkLocation = null;
546: 		clearMarkTarget();
547: 
548: 		if (walker != null)
549: 		{
550: 			walker.reset();
551: 		}
552: 
553: 		setStatus("Recovering: " + reason);
554: 	}
555: 
556: 	/**
557: 	 * If the script is started while already on the rooftop, begin at the
558: 	 * nearest obstacle on the player's current plane instead of trying to walk
559: 	 * to the ground-level first obstacle.
560: 	 */
561: 	private void alignToCourse(Player player)
562: 	{
563: 		WorldPoint location = player.getWorldLocation();
564: 		if (location == null || location.getPlane() == 0)
565: 		{
566: 			return;
567: 		}
568: 
569: 		int bestIndex = -1;
570: 		int bestDistance = Integer.MAX_VALUE;
571: 
572: 		for (int i = 0; i < COURSE.obstacles.length; i++)
573: 		{
574: 			Obstacle obstacle = COURSE.obstacles[i];
575: 			if (obstacle.location.getPlane() != location.getPlane())
576: 			{
577: 				continue;
578: 			}
579: 
580: 			int distance = location.distanceTo(obstacle.location);
581: 			if (distance < bestDistance)
582: 			{
583: 				bestDistance = distance;
584: 				bestIndex = i;
585: 			}
586: 		}
587: 
588: 		if (bestIndex >= 0)
589: 		{
590: 			index = bestIndex;
591: 			setStatus("Starting at " + COURSE.obstacles[index].name);
592: 		}
593: 	}
594: 
595: 	private TileObject findObstacle(ScriptContext context, Obstacle obstacle)
596: 	{
597: 		TileObject best = null;
598: 		int bestDistance = Integer.MAX_VALUE;
599: 
600: 		for (TileObject object : context.getTargets().getTileObjects(obstacle.location, SEARCH_RADIUS))
601: 		{
602: 			if (object.getId() != obstacle.id)
603: 			{
604: 				continue;
605: 			}
606: 
607: 			WorldPoint location = object.getWorldLocation();
608: 			if (location == null || location.getPlane() != obstacle.location.getPlane())
609: 			{
610: 				continue;
611: 			}
612: 
613: 			int distance = location.distanceTo(obstacle.location);
614: 			if (distance < bestDistance)
615: 			{
616: 				bestDistance = distance;
617: 				best = object;
618: 			}
619: 		}
620: 
621: 		return best;
622: 	}
623: 
624: 	/**
625: 	 * Handles a Mark of Grace that is on the ground at the player's current
626: 	 * course section. The mark's plane must match the player's plane and the
627: 	 * walker must be able to path to it, which stops the script from trying to
628: 	 * grab marks on the wrong part of the course.
629: 	 *
630: 	 * @return true if a mark action was taken this tick
631: 	 */
632: 	private boolean updateMarkPickup(ScriptContext context, Player player)
633: 	{
634: 		if (markTarget != null && !markStillPresent(context, markTarget))
635: 		{
636: 			// The mark was picked up or despawned.
637: 			clearMarkTarget();
638: 			return true;
639: 		}
640: 
641: 		WorldPoint playerLocation = player.getWorldLocation();
642: 		if (playerLocation == null || playerLocation.getPlane() <= 0)
643: 		{
644: 			clearMarkTarget();
645: 			return false;
646: 		}
647: 
648: 		if (markTarget == null)
649: 		{
650: 			markTarget = findMark(context, player);
651: 			if (markTarget == null)
652: 			{
653: 				return false;
654: 			}
655: 
656: 			markTicks = 0;
657: 			markAttempts = 0;
658: 		}
659: 
660: 		++markTicks;
661: 
662: 		WorldPoint markLocation = markTarget.location;
663: 
664: 		// Never chase a mark after a fall or from another course section.
665: 		if (playerLocation.getPlane() != markLocation.getPlane())
666: 		{
667: 			clearMarkTarget();
668: 			return false;
669: 		}
670: 
671: 		int distance = playerLocation.distanceTo(markLocation);
672: 		if (distance > 1)
673: 		{
674: 			if (markTicks >= MARK_WALK_TIMEOUT_TICKS)
675: 			{
676: 				ignoreMark(markLocation);
677: 				clearMarkTarget();
678: 				return false;
679: 			}
680: 
681: 			walker.walkTo(markLocation, false, 1);
682: 			setStatus("Walking to Mark of Grace");
683: 			return true;
684: 		}
685: 
686: 		if (markAttempts >= MARK_ATTEMPT_LIMIT)
687: 		{
688: 			ignoreMark(markLocation);
689: 			clearMarkTarget();
690: 			return false;
691: 		}
692: 
693: 		// Give the previous Take click a few ticks to walk over and pick the
694: 		// mark up before clicking it again.
695: 		if (markAttempts > 0 && markTicks < MARK_RETRY_TICKS)
696: 		{
697: 			setStatus("Taking Mark of Grace");
698: 			return true;
699: 		}
700: 
701: 		// Recompute the scene coordinates from the mark's world location: the
702: 		// scene base can shift while the player walks across the course.
703: 		LocalPoint local = LocalPoint.fromWorld(context.getClient(), markLocation);
704: 		if (local == null)
705: 		{
706: 			clearMarkTarget();
707: 			return false;
708: 		}
709: 
710: 		context.getInput().invokeGroundItemTake(local.getSceneX(), local.getSceneY(),
711: 			ItemID.GRACE, MARK_NAME);
712: 		++markAttempts;
713: 		markTicks = 0;
714: 		setStatus("Taking Mark of Grace");
715: 		return true;
716: 	}
717: 
718: 	private GroundLoot findMark(ScriptContext context, Player player)
719: 	{
720: 		WorldPoint playerLocation = player.getWorldLocation();
721: 		if (playerLocation == null || playerLocation.getPlane() <= 0)
722: 		{
723: 			return null;
724: 		}
725: 
726: 		WorldView worldView = context.getClient().getTopLevelWorldView();
727: 		if (worldView == null)
728: 		{
729: 			return null;
730: 		}
731: 
732: 		Scene scene = worldView.getScene();
733: 		if (scene == null)
734: 		{
735: 			return null;
736: 		}
737: 
738: 		Tile[][][] tiles = scene.getTiles();
739: 		int plane = playerLocation.getPlane();
740: 		if (tiles == null || plane < 0 || plane >= tiles.length)
741: 		{
742: 			return null;
743: 		}
744: 
745: 		Tile[][] planeTiles = tiles[plane];
746: 		if (planeTiles == null)
747: 		{
748: 			return null;
749: 		}
750: 
751: 		GroundLoot best = null;
752: 		int bestDistance = Integer.MAX_VALUE;
753: 
754: 		for (Tile[] row : planeTiles)
755: 		{
756: 			if (row == null)
757: 			{
758: 				continue;
759: 			}
760: 
761: 			for (Tile tile : row)
762: 			{
763: 				if (tile == null)
764: 				{
765: 					continue;
766: 				}
767: 
768: 				List<TileItem> groundItems = tile.getGroundItems();
769: 				if (groundItems == null || groundItems.isEmpty())
770: 				{
771: 					continue;
772: 				}
773: 
774: 				WorldPoint itemLocation = tile.getWorldLocation();
775: 				if (itemLocation == null || itemLocation.getPlane() != plane)
776: 				{
777: 					continue;
778: 				}
779: 
780: 				int distance = itemLocation.distanceTo(playerLocation);
781: 				if (distance > MARK_PICKUP_DISTANCE || distance >= bestDistance
782: 					|| isIgnoredMark(itemLocation))
783: 				{
784: 					continue;
785: 				}
786: 
787: 				boolean hasMark = false;
788: 				for (TileItem groundItem : groundItems)
789: 				{
790: 					if (groundItem != null && groundItem.getId() == ItemID.GRACE)
791: 					{
792: 						hasMark = true;
793: 						break;
794: 					}
795: 				}
796: 
797: 				if (!hasMark)
798: 				{
799: 					continue;
800: 				}
801: 
802: 				// The mark has to be walkable from where the player is right
803: 				// now; a mark across a gap or on another rooftop is skipped.
804: 				if (!walker.canReach(itemLocation))
805: 				{
806: 					continue;
807: 				}
808: 
809: 				bestDistance = distance;
810: 				best = new GroundLoot(itemLocation);
811: 			}
812: 		}
813: 
814: 		return best;
815: 	}
816: 
817: 	private boolean markStillPresent(ScriptContext context, GroundLoot mark)
818: 	{
819: 		WorldView worldView = context.getClient().getTopLevelWorldView();
820: 		if (worldView == null)
821: 		{
822: 			return false;
823: 		}
824: 
825: 		Scene scene = worldView.getScene();
826: 		if (scene == null)
827: 		{
828: 			return false;
829: 		}
830: 
831: 		Tile[][][] tiles = scene.getTiles();
832: 		int plane = mark.location.getPlane();
833: 		if (tiles == null || plane < 0 || plane >= tiles.length)
834: 		{
835: 			return false;
836: 		}
837: 
838: 		Tile[][] planeTiles = tiles[plane];
839: 		if (planeTiles == null)
840: 		{
841: 			return false;
842: 		}
843: 
844: 		int sceneX = mark.location.getX() - scene.getBaseX();
845: 		int sceneY = mark.location.getY() - scene.getBaseY();
846: 		if (sceneX < 0 || sceneX >= planeTiles.length)
847: 		{
848: 			return false;
849: 		}
850: 
851: 		Tile[] row = planeTiles[sceneX];
852: 		if (row == null || sceneY < 0 || sceneY >= row.length)
853: 		{
854: 			return false;
855: 		}
856: 
857: 		Tile tile = row[sceneY];

```java
	{
```

		return tilePoly != null && isMouseOver(tilePoly);

258: 	private Stream<GameObject> objects()
259: 	{
260: 		return tiles().flatMap(tile ->
261: 		{
262: 			GameObject[] gameObjects = tile.getGameObjects();
263: 			return gameObjects == null ? Stream.empty() : Arrays.stream(gameObjects);
264: 		})
265: 			.filter(Objects::nonNull);
266: 	}

268: 	private Stream<TileObject> tileObjects()
269: 	{
270: 		return tiles().flatMap(tile ->
271: 		{
272: 			List<TileObject> objects = new ArrayList<>();
273: 			GameObject[] gameObjects = tile.getGameObjects();
274: 			if (gameObjects != null)
275: 			{
276: 				Collections.addAll(objects, gameObjects);
277: 			}
278: 			if (tile.getGroundObject() != null)
279: 			{
280: 				objects.add(tile.getGroundObject());
281: 			}
282: 			if (tile.getWallObject() != null)
283: 			{
284: 				objects.add(tile.getWallObject());
285: 			}
286: 			if (tile.getDecorativeObject() != null)
287: 			{
288: 				objects.add(tile.getDecorativeObject());
289: 			}
290: 
291: 			return objects.stream().filter(Objects::nonNull);
292: 		});
293: 	}
294: 
295: 	private Stream<Tile> tiles()
296: 	{
297: 		WorldView worldView = client.getTopLevelWorldView();
298: 		if (worldView == null)
299: 		{
300: 			return Stream.empty();
301: 		}
302: 
303: 		Scene scene = worldView.getScene();
304: 		if (scene == null)
305: 		{
306: 			return Stream.empty();
307: 		}
308: 
309: 		Tile[][][] tiles = scene.getTiles();
310: 		int plane = worldView.getPlane();
311: 		if (tiles == null || plane < 0 || plane >= tiles.length)
312: 		{
313: 			return Stream.empty();
314: 		}
315: 
316: 		Tile[][] planeTiles = tiles[plane];
317: 		if (planeTiles == null)
318: 		{
319: 			return Stream.empty();
320: 		}
321: 
322: 		return Arrays.stream(planeTiles)
323: 			.filter(Objects::nonNull)
324: 			.flatMap(row -> Arrays.stream(row))
325: 			.filter(Objects::nonNull);
326: 	}
327:

329: 	{
330: 		WorldView worldView = client.getTopLevelWorldView();
331: 		if (worldView == null)
332: 		{
333: 			return Stream.empty();
334: 		}
335: 
336: 		return worldView.npcs().stream()
337: 			.map(npc -> (NPC) npc)
338: 			.filter(npc -> !npc.isDead());
339: 	}

345: 			return true;
346: 		}
347: 
348: 		ObjectComposition composition = client.getObjectDefinition(object.getId());
349: 		return composition != null && clean(composition.getName()).equalsIgnoreCase(clean(name));
350: 	}

353: 	{
354: 		if (name == null || name.isEmpty())
355: 		{
356: 			return true;
357: 		}
358: 
359: 		NPCComposition composition = npc.getComposition();
360: 		String npcName = composition == null ? npc.getName() : composition.getName();
361: 		return clean(npcName).equalsIgnoreCase(clean(name));
362: 	}

365: 	{

367: 		return composition != null && hasAction(composition.getActions(), action);
368: 	}

371: 	{
372: 		NPCComposition composition = npc.getComposition();
373: 		return composition != null && hasAction(composition.getActions(), action);
374: 	}

376: 	private static boolean hasAction(String[] actions, String action)
377: 	{
378: 		return actions != null && Arrays.stream(actions).filter(Objects::nonNull)
379: 			.anyMatch(candidate -> clean(candidate).equalsIgnoreCase(clean(action)));
380: 	}
381: 
382: 	private boolean isVisible(TileObject object)
383: 	{
384: 		Shape clickbox = object.getClickbox();
385: 		if (clickbox != null && isInViewport(clickbox))
386: 		{
387: 			return true;
388: 		}
389: 
390: 		Polygon tilePoly = object.getCanvasTilePoly();
391: 		return tilePoly != null && isInViewport(tilePoly);
392: 	}
393: 
394: 	private boolean isVisible(NPC npc)
395: 	{
396: 		Shape hull = npc.getConvexHull();
397: 		if (hull != null && isInViewport(hull))
398: 		{
399: 			return true;
400: 		}
401: 
402: 		Polygon tilePoly = npc.getCanvasTilePoly();
403: 		return tilePoly != null && isInViewport(tilePoly);
404: 	}
405: 
406: 	private boolean isInViewport(Shape shape)
407: 	{
408: 		if (shape == null)
409: 		{
410: 			return false;
411: 		}
412: 
413: 		int width = client.getViewportWidth();
414: 		int height = client.getViewportHeight();
415: 		if (width <= 0 || height <= 0)
416: 		{
417: 			return true;
418: 		}
419: 
420: 		// Shape.intersects is unreliable here: RuneLite's SimplePolygon only
421: 		// returns true when the viewport border crosses the polygon, not when
422: 		// the whole polygon is inside the viewport. Compare bounds instead.
423: 		Rectangle bounds = shape.getBounds();
424: 		if (bounds == null)
425: 		{
426: 			return false;
427: 		}
428: 
429: 		Rectangle viewport = new Rectangle(
430: 			client.getViewportXOffset(), client.getViewportYOffset(), width, height);
431: 		if (bounds.width <= 0 || bounds.height <= 0)
432: 		{
433: 			return viewport.contains(bounds.getLocation());
434: 		}
435: 
436: 		return viewport.intersects(bounds);
437: 	}
438: 
439: 	private static boolean withinDistance(WorldPoint point, WorldPoint origin, int maxDistance)
440: 	{
441: 		return maxDistance <= 0 || origin == null || distance(point, origin) <= maxDistance;
442: 	}
443: 
444: 	private static int distance(WorldPoint point, WorldPoint origin)
445: 	{
446: 		return point == null || origin == null ? Integer.MAX_VALUE : point.distanceTo(origin);
447: 	}
448: 
449: 	private static String clean(String value)
450: 	{
451: 		return value == null ? "" : TAGS.matcher(value).replaceAll("").trim();
452: 	}
453: }

```java
/**
 * Finds every tile object within 2D distance of a world position, even when
 * the position is on another plane. Only objects on the current scene plane
 * are returned, since that is all that is loaded. Used for rooftop courses,
 * whose obstacle positions are stored on varying planes.
 */
public List<TileObject> getTileObjectsNear(WorldPoint location, int radius)
{
    if (location == null)
    {
        return Collections.emptyList();
    }

    int limit = Math.max(0, radius);
    return tileObjects()
        .filter(object ->
        {
            WorldPoint objectLocation = object.getWorldLocation();
            return objectLocation != null
                && objectLocation.distanceTo2D(location) <= limit;
        })
        .collect(Collectors.toList());
}
```

```java
private boolean crossedObstacle(Obstacle obstacle, WorldPoint location)
{
    if (waitStartLocation == null || location == null)
    {
        return false;
    }

    int moved = waitStartLocation.distanceTo2D(location);
    if (moved < MOVE_ONLY_MIN_CROSS_DISTANCE)

    int towardX = obstacle.location.getX() - waitStartLocation.getX();
    int towardY = obstacle.location.getY() - waitStartLocation.getY();
    int passedX = location.getX() - waitStartLocation.getX();
    int passedY = location.getY() - waitStartLocation.getY();

    int lengthSquared = towardX * towardX + towardY * towardY;
    return lengthSquared == 0 || passedX * towardX + passedY * towardY > lengthSquared;
}
```

```java
/**
 * Finds every tile object within the given 2D radius of a world position on
 * a specific scene plane. Unlike {@link #getTileObjectsNear}, this can look
 * at planes other than the player's, which rooftop obstacles sometimes use.
 */
public List<TileObject> getTileObjectsOnPlane(WorldPoint location, int radius, int plane)
{
    if (location == null) return Collections.emptyList();

    WorldView worldView = client.getTopLevelWorldView();
    if (worldView == null) return Collections.emptyList();
    Scene scene = worldView.getScene();
    if (scene == null) return Collections.emptyList();

    Tile[][][] tiles = scene.getTiles();
    if (tiles == null || plane < 0 || plane >= tiles.length) return Collections.emptyList();

    Tile[][] planeTiles = tiles[plane];
    if (planeTiles == null) return Collections.emptyList();

    int limit = Math.max(0, radius);
    List<TileObject> found = new ArrayList<>();
    for (Tile[] row : planeTiles)
    {
        if (row == null) continue;
        for (Tile tile : row)
        {
            if (tile == null) continue;
            WorldPoint tileLocation = tile.getWorldLocation();
            if (tileLocation == null || tileLocation.distanceTo2D(location) > limit) continue;

            GameObject[] gameObjects = tile.getGameObjects();
            if (gameObjects != null)
            {
                for (GameObject object : gameObjects)
                {
                    if (object != null) found.add(object);
                }
            }
            if (tile.getGroundObject() != null) found.add(tile.getGroundObject());
            if (tile.getWallObject() != null) found.add(tile.getWallObject());
            if (tile.getDecorativeObject() != null) found.add(tile.getDecorativeObject());
        }
    }

    return found;
}
```
